environment.description: ECS Fargate task running notification-consumer-role-prod. DynamoDB table has fine-grained access control via IAM condition key dynamodb:LeadingKeys with ForAllValues:StringLike condition bound to ${aws:PrincipalTag/ServicePrefix}#*. The consumer role has principal tag ServicePrefix=SYSTEM and the condition restricts PutItem to items where pk begins with 'SYSTEM#'. The frontend API role (separate) reads items with pk='USER#${cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:sub}' via its own condition. Additionally, the notification-reader Lambda has a DynamoDB Streams trigger that applies DOMPurify sanitization before setting rendered=true, and the frontend GraphQL resolver filters on rendered=true AND applies a secondary server-side HTML entity encoding pass. The SQS queue has a resource policy restricting SendMessage to only the internal event-bus service role (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/event-bus-publisher) which validates message schema including max field lengths and alphanumeric-plus-basic-punctuation regex on body/title fields before publishing.

config.event_bus_validation: Schema validation with regex ^[\w\s.,!?'\-()]{1,500}$ on body and title fields
config.dynamodb_streams_sanitizer: Lambda applies DOMPurify before marking rendered=true
config.frontend_filter: GraphQL resolver returns only items where rendered=true with additional server-side encoding
